caption: The same uncut kitchen shot continues without a transition. The same middle-aged chef continues turning away from the camera toward the stove while remaining behind the stainless steel counter. His shaved head, close gray beard seen from the side, white chef jacket with black buttons, cobalt blue apron, red thermometer on the left chest pocket, and the white plate with three basil leaves remain consistent. Smooth continuous motion, no jump cut, warm restaurant kitchen lighting.
